hypothesis: The exact MU 15m breakout-pressure route may add a repeatable source-native edge after finite-depth fills, fees, funding, latency, stop behavior, and one-position-per-route lifecycle accounting.
decision: Keep MU report-only with no v53 live change. The first resolved short stopped out and the current exact prospective replay is negative under both nominal and stress costs. The long slice remains positive only because one winner dominates, while nine of thirteen processed lifecycle episodes remain technically censored. Do not promote, resize, retune, or select a side from this sample; continue the frozen prospective collection and transport-parity window.
falsifier: Reconsider only after a predeclared larger exact-source window has at least 20 independent onsets and 12 resolved lifecycle episodes, represents both sides, resolves material path gaps without synthetic prices, and remains positive under stress after removing the largest winner. Reject the candidate if the larger both-side sample remains non-positive or technically unresolved.

proposal_contract.recommendation: Keep MU report-only and preserve the frozen route while collecting exact prospective mark, depth, funding, and both-side exit evidence.
proposal_contract.why_now: Two new eligible onsets added the first resolved short and changed aggregate lifecycle economics from positive-but-outlier-dependent to negative after realistic costs.
proposal_contract.evidence_reviewed: The immutable 467-decision and 74139-book snapshot, 476182 exact websocket marks, official funding, measured fee evidence, stress friction, and the unchanged frozen lifecycle contract.
proposal_contract.observed_problem_or_opportunity: Only four lifecycle episodes resolve causally; the first short lost at its stop, combined nominal and stress economics are negative, and the positive long aggregate disappears after removing one winner.
proposal_contract.applicable_market_regime: Evidence remains concentrated in 15m breakouts with EMA9 versus EMA21 and depth-10 pressure; the sample is too small and technically incomplete to establish regime-conditional edge.
proposal_contract.alternatives_considered: Immediate live addition, long-only post-hoc selection, parameter retuning, relaxed mark-gap standards, REST substitution, synthetic path repair, and continued frozen prospective capture. Only continued capture preserves the predeclared causal contract.
proposal_contract.expected_upside: A larger exact both-side lifecycle sample can distinguish a repeatable edge from outlier concentration without exposing v53 capital to an unqualified route.
proposal_contract.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Small sample error, largest-winner dependence, technically censored lifecycles, unresolved source transport parity, fees and funding erasing gross edge, and next-observed-depth exits differing from venue fills.
proposal_contract.validation_completed: Onset identity reconciled 14 of 14; one-position portfolio accounting, side attribution, fees, funding, residual latency, stress costs, signal exits, and stop exits were replayed from immutable inputs; every consumed file was rehashed.
proposal_contract.validation_still_required: The fixed 24-hour transport-parity window, at least 20 onsets and 12 resolved lifecycles, both-side representation beyond one short, exact capture continuity, complete depth-sized entry and exit paths, and positive stress economics after largest-winner removal.
proposal_contract.success_metrics: At least 20 independent prospective onsets, at least 12 resolved lifecycle episodes with both sides represented, positive stress net and stress net excluding the largest winner, no synthetic path repair, and no unresolved source identity.
proposal_contract.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Negative stress or ex-largest economics in the larger window, persistent material censoring, fee/funding drag exceeding gross edge, source/transport mismatch, or evidence-integrity failure.

limitations: Nine of thirteen processed lifecycle episodes remain technically censored and cannot support economic claims.
Only one short lifecycle resolves, and it is a stopped loss; this does not establish a stable short-side distribution.
The positive long aggregate becomes negative after removing its largest winner.
Combined nominal and stress economics are negative after measured fees, funding, and residual latency.
The fixed transport-parity window remains incomplete and current transport blockers are unresolved.
Mark-triggered next-observed-depth exits are replay approximations rather than historical venue fills.
The stated sample sizes are investigation thresholds, not profitability or live-promotion gates.
No v53 strategy, asset, route, parameter, leverage, sizing, exit, execution, or deployment setting changed.
